findings.claim: Java Pattern cannot provide complete native ECMAScript RegExp semantics by direct delegation.
router2.2.0 preserves native RegExp g/y lastIndex across matches.
findings.observation: Three identical matches with one g/y object produce true,false,true; lastIndex6,0,6.

findings.claim: Java8-compatible Rhino1.7.15.1 is insufficient for full native RegExp parity.
findings.observation: u,d,v flags, named groups and lookbehind rejected.

findings.claim: QuickJS2026-06-04 is a candidate engine, not a validated drop-in oracle.
findings.observation: Host build works and modern flags/features sampled work; alternate duplicate names accepted unlike pinned V8;260 captures rejected unlike pinned V8;Android/JNI untested.

findings.claim: Capture-key naming must reproduce router source scanning rather than simply use engine group-name metadata.
findings.observation: Escaped literal parentheses preceding named capture make pinned router expose the captured value as numeric key0.

recommendation: Keep full Express5 native-RegExp parity; define engine-neutral EcmaRegExp object and exec facade, then validate an engine architecture. Split engine validation from route integration. Do not freeze Java Pattern as an assumed complete mapping.

options.name: ECMAScript object facade plus verified native RegExp backend
options.candidate: QuickJS libregexp/libunicode through JNI, or a V8-aligned native implementation
required_work: V8 grammar/capture-limit compatibility, including current QuickJS counterexamples
router-specific capture-name scan and URI decoding
shared g/y lastIndex identity and serialized exec
Java8 JNI API and Android21 ABI/NDK/packaging/lifecycle proof
full pinned native-RegExp differential and applicable test262 coverage
options.risk: Native packaging expands supported build/runtime architecture; current candidate does not yet pass full oracle.

options.name: Portable Java8 ECMAScript RegExp parser and VM
options.candidate: Dedicated VM or carefully backported complete implementation with pinned Unicode tables
required_work: ECMAScript grammar and exec semantics beyond Java Pattern
real Java8 and Android21 performance/conformance verification
options.risk: Substantial engine project; not a small Pattern translator or overload addition.

options.name: Java Pattern analogue as an additional NaruServe extension
options.reason: May coexist as explicitly named native-Java extension; cannot satisfy the ECMAScript RegExp path requirement.

native ABI packaging and minimum API if choosing O1
large capture groups and duplicate-name syntax validation
shared state ordering under concurrent requests
allocation/cancellation/timeout behavior without changing declared matching semantics
dependency/module/licensing changes permitted by architecture contract
